title: Provenance of GenAI text in student proposals (FLoRA): measurement, detection and grading (code, analysis plans, statistics)
description: Code, time-stamped analysis plans and statistics files for a study of verbatim uptake of chatbot text in students' submitted project proposals (FLoRA Open Data IPS, 275 students). Uptake is measured from n-gram overlap, corrected for text the student pasted into prompts, and validated against writing-log provenance. All analyses are exploratory. No third-party data are redistributed.
